name: Nehan no Mori
source:
Early in the morning you went to explore mount Fuji and got lost. There are a lot of spirits there aiming to make you a resident of the Demon World. Escape from the demon world by using physical strength and intelligence.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
清晨，你前去探索富士山，卻迷了路。那裡有許多幽靈，想讓你成為魔界的居民。運用體力與智慧，逃出魔界吧。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
